title: More World Height
description: This Project Adds More world height for Overworld! And will add also for Nether and End!
body:
# • What is Does?

This Datapack Adds more world height for every dimenson Overworld, Nether, and End

It is Pretty usefull for survival and hardcore so you can make very big projects.

 ## • Compability?

Datapack works for every version
from 1.13-1.21 and higher.
